content.text: Check covers data/2025-*, so it validated the new file.

I moved `inbox/2025-12.csv` into `data/` and committed it as `8975a19 2025-12: add rows`. That follows the project's rule of starting commit messages with the data month.

Before committing I ran `scripts/check.sh`, which printed OK. It checks every `data/2025-*.csv` file, so the new file was included. It found no row with the wrong number of fields.

Git ignores `inbox/`, so the move from the inbox doesn't show up in the commit. Only the new 32-line file in `data/` does.
